title: Marginal Persistence and Dynamic Copula Dependence in Sovereign Rating Migration Counts: A Discrete Interval-Likelihood MAGMAR Analysis
summary: This paper develops an observed-data likelihood for applying moving-aggregate modified autoregressive (MAGMAR) copula time-series models to discrete sovereign rating-migration counts with time-varying exposure. An annual count identifies a probability-integral-transform interval rather than a unique latent point, so the likelihood integrates the latent process over the complete sequence of count intervals.
